attempts.why_died: One line can serve every walk: a line with one fixed bit of every pigeon keeps rank about n/2 under every half-cube restriction, so no high-rank line is killed. Rank gives depth n/4 only.

formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ l : ℕ, ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin (2 ^ l + 1) × Fin l)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ l + 1) l) π → p.eval (2 ^ l) < π.length
plain_statement: No polynomial in the number of holes bounds the length of dag-like Res(+) refutations of bit pigeonhole with 2^l + 1 pigeons. Open in refereed work through 2026 (ECCC TR26-018); claimed with bound 2^Omega(n/log^2 n) by the unrefereed preprint arXiv:2609.23015, which this project has not verified.
title: TARGET (open in refereed work): Res(+) refutations of bit pigeonhole are not polynomially bounded
